deviations_from_card: (1) To keep first paint near zero, the fallback when places.ts has not loaded yet is gone: a move made before the lazy module arrives (that includes the reload-at-a-depth seq bump in startDepth) now leaves focus where it was, where before it focused the layer. The module loads right after the first frame. (2) places.ts re-exports the still as capture/show, and Stage now lazy-loads ./places instead of ./still (one lazy module). A's mountCounting now awaits ./places. (3) The record is taken during the render that works out the move (from top.current, with an eslint-disable for react-hooks/refs and the reason written next to it), so calm moves are recorded too. Added one calm case that was not on the card. (4) The locator is the child-index path plus tag and text. There is no data-attribute key. (5) Card case 5 also asserts the scroll comes back, so that it fails on today's tree. No ADR, because the card lists none.
